limits.source: own cap of 9,000 below the 10,000 calls per account and day in Govee's v1 API PDF; the v2 reference (get-you-devices, 'Friendly Reminder', 2026-07-06) names per-minute limits per device and account but no daily one — kept by the rate limiter (CLOUD_LIMITS.perDay)

own cap of the adapter — Govee documents none for this undocumented app endpoint: one call a second on average; every request waits at the call gate (call-gate.ts) until it fits, and the libraries keep their own lane of 8 a minute (rate-limiter.ts)
own cap of the adapter — the Govee app version is looked up once per adapter start and once a day; a restart right after a start makes two within a minute, the call gate (call-gate.ts) holds a third
own cap of the adapter — Govee documents none; the client only connects, subscribes and pings every 60 s, and reconnects back off from 5 s doubling (reconnecting-mqtt-client)

own cap of the adapter — Govee documents none (K18 research 2026-10-08); the client lets at most this cap less 40 protocol writes (TLS, connect, subscribe, the 60 s keepalive under the 5 s doubling reconnect backoff) out as commands and status requests per minute, and refuses the rest (govee-mqtt-client)
own cap of the adapter — one scan datagram per target every 30 s plus the scan at start; the scan skips a target that would go over it (govee-lan-client)
own cap of the adapter — Govee's LAN API documents none; the LAN client delays a datagram that would go over it (govee-lan-client)
